import unittest
from vdom import h, diff, apply_patches, ReplaceNode, UpdateProps

class TestVDOMReconciler(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_prop_updates(self):
        old = h('button', {'class': 'btn', 'disabled': True}, text='Click')
        new = h('button', {'class': 'btn btn-primary', 'id': 'submit-btn'}, text='Click')
        patches = diff(old, new)
        res = apply_patches(old, patches)
        self.assertEqual(res.props.get('class'), 'btn btn-primary')
        self.assertEqual(res.props.get('id'), 'submit-btn')
        self.assertNotIn('disabled', res.props)

    def test_keyed_children_reorder_and_insert(self):
        old = h('ul', {}, [
            h('li', {}, key='1', text='Item 1'),
            h('li', {}, key='2', text='Item 2'),
        ])
        new = h('ul', {}, [
            h('li', {}, key='2', text='Item 2'),
            h('li', {}, key='3', text='Item 3'),
            h('li', {}, key='1', text='Item 1 (Updated)'),
        ])
        patches = diff(old, new)
        res = apply_patches(old, patches)
        self.assertEqual(len(res.children), 3)
        self.assertEqual(res.children[0].key, '2')
        self.assertEqual(res.children[1].key, '3')
        self.assertEqual(res.children[2].key, '1')
        self.assertEqual(res.children[2].text, 'Item 1 (Updated)')

if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
